market.question: Will the lowest temperature in London be 8°C on April 28?

assessment.reasoning: London late-April 2026 forecasts show overnight lows roughly 7-12°C. The 8°C bucket (7.5-8.5°C) is plausible but only one of ~5-6 likely buckets. Market 0.35 seems reasonable; my central estimate ~0.30.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Exact London City Airport overnight low can vary +/- 2°C from city center forecast.
